t: Average Value of Even Numbers Divisible by Three — Filter
o: Even and divisible by 3 means divisible by 6. Filter nums for x % 6 == 0, then return floor(sum/count), or 0 if none exist. Example 1: 6 and 12 qualify, (6+12)/2 = 9. Example 2 has no multiples of 6, so 0. Values are at most 1000 and n at most 1000, so sums fit easily in any integer type.
k: Guard division by zero when no qualifying numbers exist.
Floor division matches the required rounding.

a.n: Approach 1: Single Pass Filter and Sum
a.i: Accumulate sum and count of multiples of 6 in one pass, then integer-divide. Trivially optimal.
s: For each x with x%6==0: sum+=x, cnt++.

w: Trivial problem; the only traps are returning NaN/exception on empty filters and using float division. Mention that x%2==0 && x%3==0 is equivalent to x%6==0 if asked to justify.
